review_findings: Manual create now requires --domain and --keyword search metadata.
Workflow draft/write now accepts only type=validation-receipt records with command or validation evidence.
relate now requires --confirm for supersedes/conflicts_with, updates current flags, and rolls back invalid graph writes.
import now rejects accepted receiptless ADRs unless legacy markers/import notes are explicit.
Topic names are normalized/rejected before any .plan reads.
create/write roll back new Markdown and restore graph JSONL when post-write validation fails.
draft can derive preview metadata from proposal text and validation receipts when caller fields are omitted.
Validation-receipt gating now requires substantive non-empty command or validation evidence.
Workflow write checks topic ADR intent and validation receipts before create=True ADR directory discovery, so rejected writes leave no docs/adr artifacts.
Manual create and workflow write now preflight user input before ADR directory creation.
write_record_and_graph now removes new Markdown, graph files, graph directories, and ADR directories on post-validation failure when they did not exist before.
